title: Titanium Quartz Window Retainer
system: UHV Sealing Rings & Chamber Compression Hardware
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Quartz Window Retainer because its non-magnetic permeability (µ <1.0001) eliminates interference with electron beam trajectories in vacuum processing chambers. The low sputter yield of Ti (0.3 atoms/ion at 500eV Ar+) compared to Al (1.2) reduces cross-contamination in thin-film deposition tools. Matched thermal expansion (8.6 µm/m°C) with ceramic end-effectors prevents particle generation during thermal cycling — critical for Quartz window retaining bezel ring. This rationale is driven by quartz window retaining bezel ring and fat life requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber hardware geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with SPC sampling
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for quartz window retaining application
commonFailures: Virtual leak from dead-leg threaded connections - remedied by VCR/Swagelok face-seal fittings — critical for quartz window retaining performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Quartz Window Retainer compatible with fluorine-based process chemistries?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has excellent resistance to NF₃, CF₄, SF₆, and other fluorine-based plasma chemistries used in semiconductor etching and chamber cleaning. The TiO₂ passive layer forms a stable TiF₄ reaction product that does not spall or generate particles. However, Titanium Quartz Window Retainer should not be used in HF-containing wet processes where corrosion rates exceed 0.5 mm/year.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Quartz Window Retainer orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Quartz Window Retainer is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Quartz Window Retainer?
faq.a: Each Titanium Quartz Window Retainer shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for quartz window retaining.
